dedupe_keys.name: high resolution multi scale industrial water use dataset in china plant level 1998 2014 with water extended mrio

description: This package gives processed plant-level industrial water use for China with year, output, province, city and county, 2 to 4 digit industrial sub-sector, MRIO sector codes and detailed water use, recycling and pollution variables. The Zenodo record says it also has county, city and province aggregates, national statistics bureau macro data for comparison, 42 water satellite accounts, and interprovincial MRIO trade tables for 31 provinces from 1998 to 2014, plus Stata, Python and R code to build the dataset and a water-extended MRIO model. It was published in September 2024 by a research team of four authors under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as data and code zips of about 265 and 190 MB. Coverage is China, 1998 to 2014. Caveats: the plant data are processed from a source not named in the record, and plant identities may be withheld. For simulation it gives plant and sector water demand with interprovincial trade to model drought and water restriction impacts on industry and their spread through supply chains. Related catalogue records include the global gridded industrial water use dataset and the USGS industrial water use for 2020.
name: High-resolution multi-scale industrial water use dataset in China (plant level, 1998-2014) with water-extended MRIO
